One isolated subject centered in a square canvas, entire object visible with 8 percent transparent margin, strong silhouette readable at 48 pixels. Light from upper left, crisp controlled edges and highlights, no excessive glow. Output a native transparent PNG with preserved RGBA alpha. Surrounding space and all internal empty gaps must be fully transparent. No scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, frame, cast shadow, pedestal, UI, text, watermark, logos, extra objects or multiple variants. One matched pair of wearable boots arranged as a compact single inventory icon, one slightly behind the other, both soles visible, empty boots with no feet. Cohesive set identity: deep storm-blue and violet woven mage fabric, bronze conductive coil fastenings and raised silver lightning motifs, restrained violet energy only in fine seams. Make this boots original and visibly distinct from every other set. Keep the entire wearable object inside the canvas.
